news.title: ASX set to fall as Nvidia drives Wall Street sharply lower
news.snippet: Nvidia led another sell-off in technology stocks and helped drag the US market lower.

news.title: Forrestania grabs control of Zenith in WA gold power play
news.snippet: Forrestania Resources has locked in a controlling 72.56 per cent stake in Zenith Minerals, closing its takeover offer and advancing its WA gold consolidation strategy.

news.title: Westpac’s rolling job cuts near 300 positions as banks swing axe
news.snippet: The country’s oldest bank has not made a headline-grabbing announcement like its peers, but its cuts are adding up.

news.title: Westfield owner is scoping out replacements for David Jones
news.snippet: The owner of Westfield shopping centres has ramped up pressure on David Jones administrators, who are meeting with creditors for the first time on Tuesday.

news.title: Locksley unveils major resource lift at NSW copper-gold play
news.snippet: Locksley Resources has grown its Greater Tottenham resource to 110,000 tonnes of copper and 100,000 ounces of gold, with a rig now on site in NSW to test for extensions.

news.title: Lowering barriers: how tech is empowering entrepreneurs
Gateway nails another high-grade gold discovery near Wiluna in WA
news.snippet: Gateway Mining has hit shallow, high-grade gold at its Yandal project in WA, with recent RC drilling returning 11m at 4.5g/t gold from 89m, confirming a new mineralised system.

news.title: Critical gets boots on ground at high-grade NSW antimony play
news.snippet: Critical Resources has gained access to its Mayview antimony-gold prospect in NSW, where rock chips hit 52.3 per cent antimony, just 2.7km from Larvotto’s Hillgrove mine.
